items.title: LLM Networking with MikroTik
items.author: gregsadetsky
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are advanced AI systems that generate human-like responses based on extensive training data. They are used in networking for tasks like traffic management and intelligent routing. MikroTik devices utilize LLMs for enhanced network automation and optimization.

items.title: Nul Characters in Strings in SQLite
items.author: basilikum
items.summary: In SQLite, a NUL character (`\0`) is treated as a string terminator, meaning it ends the string at that point. NUL characters can cause issues in data storage and retrieval. To handle them, use functions like `REPLACE` to remove or replace them.

items.title: Job queues are deceptively tricky
items.author: ingve
items.summary: Job queues can be complex and challenging to manage due to their intricate scheduling and prioritization processes. They often require careful design to ensure efficiency and fairness. Advanced algorithms are typically needed to handle job queues effectively.

items.title: Book prizes don't work how you think
items.author: samclemens
items.summary: Book prizes often favor unique, unconventional narratives over traditional execution. They tend to highlight controversial or challenging subject matters. The selection process can be subjective and influenced by judges' personal tastes.

items.author: benswerd
items.summary: Brainless is a Shadcn component library that mimics the visual styles of Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. It offers React components for coding agent terminals. Install via bunx shadcn add @brainless/component.

items.title: P2P local file transfer based on WebRTC
items.author: halb
items.summary: P2P local file transfer using WebRTC enables direct device-to-device data exchange without a central server, offering fast and secure file sharing over local networks. WebRTC's RTCDataChannel facilitates real-time file transfers. No cloud storage or intermediary servers are needed.

items.title: Designing APIs for Agents
items.author: benswerd
items.summary: Designing APIs for AI agents focuses on behavioral guidelines and usage scenarios, unlike traditional APIs. They must accommodate the probabilistic nature of large language models. Key principles include context-aware design and better API discoverability.

items.title: Show HN: Low-latency local LLM runner via OpenJDK Panama FFM (Java 22)
items.author: KingJoker
items.text:

It still uses Project Panama to interface directly with llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and ggml compute graphs.

items.summary: A low-latency local LLM runner is available using OpenJDK Panama FFM in Java 22. It interfaces directly with models like llama.cpp and whisper.cpp. Libargus.cc provides a structured API for JVM integration.

items.title: Telegram Serverless
items.author: soheilpro
